title: 银行借贷签约特写
prompt: Black-and-white observational documentary footage for a serious economics explainer. Neutral grayscale silver-gelatin photography, detailed faces and material textures, soft daylight, moderate contrast, clear readable composition. Original illustrative reconstruction. Natural restrained gestures, physically coherent objects and hands. Landscape 16:9. One continuous shot, gentle camera movement only. No subtitles, no readable lettering, no logos, no watermark, no graphic overlays. Close shot at an ordinary contemporary bank desk. An East Asian male property developer in a dark jacket receives a pen from a female loan officer, signs a single page of a thick loan contract and slides it back to her. Loan officer checks the signature. Faces partly visible above desk, natural anatomically correct hands. Paper contract and signing action are the main subject.
